g.text: | LOCAL-FIRST FAIL-CLOSED APPSEC GATE & HARDENED CONTAINER ENGINE

Limits parallel scanner containers (default: 2) to prevent workstation CPU/RAM thrashing.
Dynamic rule thresholds; zero tolerance on leaked secrets. Overridable via KURO_POLICY_PATH.
